_comment: Local names for Famly session and product UUIDs, used to label the Slack
plan-preview summary. Famly's plans response identifies sessions and
products by UUID only and carries no titles, so they are mapped here.
Fill in the name against each UUID. An entry left empty (or an id absent
from this file) falls back to showing the raw UUID, so a half-filled file
is safe -- it never blocks a preview or a Slack post.
Sessions come in two sets of three: funded and unfunded.
Replace the PASTE-... placeholder keys with the real UUIDs.
The file is re-read on every preview, so edits take effect without a
server restart. Point FAMLY_CATALOGUE_FILE elsewhere to override the path.
SITES: each key is the site_code HubSpot sends (matched case-insensitively).
Fill in `label` (shown to the approver in Slack) and `institutionId`
(Famly's institution UUID for that site). BOTH MAY BE LEFT EMPTY: the code
still resolves, the label falls back to the code, and institution_id stays
null. institutionId is METADATA ONLY today -- nothing sends it to Famly.
Session and product names stay in the flat maps below: UUIDs are globally
unique, so they need no per-site grouping to be named correctly.
